topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: Hey, can you believe this? I found out Alex has been writing this whole novel about me. It’s like, wow, I knew they had a way with words, but this is just...I don’t know, it’s intense and sweet at the same time. I mean, who does that? It’s kinda flattering, you know? Shows they’ve really been paying attention to all the little things, the way I laugh when I’m surprised or how I always keep a spare umbrella in my car. I’m actually excited to read it. I think it’ll be amazing, and it makes me feel even closer to them. Can’t wait to see what they’ve written!
